purpose: Teach: まんま/とび/破っ/お方/挟ま/うなずい/つかえ/ぶら

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、寝間着のまんま登校したろ?
lines.en: Riku — you came to school in your pajamas, didn't you?
lines.style: Playful, knowing lilt on the question. Sharp eyes. Teasing someone she's close enough to call out without malice. Fast, confident delivery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、運動会でとびの真似してたな、桜
lines.en: You were doing that bird impression at the sports day, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry, deflecting counterattack. Almost a smile in the voice. Not defensive—just turning the tables. Level, steady tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、約束を破ったぜ
lines.style: Accusation with teeth, but no real anger underneath. Sharp opening. Slight pause before the verb lands. Testing him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のお祖父ちゃん、立派なお方だな、桜
lines.en: Your grandfather is a pretty great man, Sakura.
lines.style: Genuine admiration, carefully delivered. Warm but slightly formal—respect in the tone. No performance, just honest. Soft landing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ぼくと隣のクラスの間に挟まれてんな
lines.en: Riku, you're stuck between me and the class next door, aren't you?
lines.style: Quiet observation, almost to herself. Thoughtful, noticing something he probably doesn't realize she sees. Gentle, introspective tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、授業中うなずいてばかりだな、桜
lines.en: You just nod along in class all the time, don't you?
lines.style: Light teasing with an edge of actual noticing. Gentle mockery. Quick pace on the observation, trailing warmth at the end.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のスマホ、ポケットにつかえてんぞ
lines.en: Riku, your phone is stuck in your pocket.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact callout with dry humor. Pointing out the obvious without judgment. Quick, practical delivery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、駅前をぶらっとしてきたろ?桜
lines.en: You stopped by the station area on the way, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Curious, fishing gently. Intimate tone—close enough to notice, close enough to ask. Soft, interested cadence. No accusation, just wondering.
